purpose: Teach: 借地/集成/私有/兼業/満了/抹消/協約/家主

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 土地は借地のままでいきましょう
lines.en: Let's keep the land on a leasehold basis.
lines.style: Efficient, matter-of-fact opening. Clear decision-maker tone. Brisk pace, no lingering. Practical and final without sounding cold.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員のアイデアを集成したノートを共有します
lines.en: Understood. I'll compile the staff suggestions and share the notes.
lines.style: Prompt, responsive agreement. Slightly warmer than the direction given. Shows capability and follow-through without overstatement. Quick steady pace.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 私有のアプリは業務に使わせないように指導しましょう
lines.en: We should make sure employees understand not to use personal apps for work.
lines.style: Instructional tone, calm authority. Light emphasis on the policy boundary. Measured pace, steady eye-level. Guiding without punishing.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。兼業届の様式を新しくしました
lines.en: Got it. I've updated the side-job declaration form.
lines.style: Quick, competent delivery. Confirms task completion without fanfare. Subtle pride in the follow-through. Efficient, forward-moving.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 保険契約の満了日を一覧化しましょう
lines.en: Let's create a consolidated list of all insurance contract expiration dates.
lines.style: Methodical, administrative focus. Slight emphasis on thoroughness. Even pace, structured. Clear expectation-setting without urgency.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。退職者の社内アカウントを抹消しました
lines.en: Done. I've already removed the former employees' internal accounts.
lines.style: Confident, task-complete. Small note of readiness in the delivery — this was already handled. Steady, reliable tone. No seeking of approval.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 労使協約を更新しましょう
lines.en: And we'll need to update the labor agreement.
lines.style: Formal procedural note, slight shift to gravitas. Measured, deliberate pace. The tone of someone marking off necessary business before closure.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。家主との関係を良好に保ちます
lines.en: Yes. I'll make sure we maintain a good relationship with the property owner.
lines.style: Warm closing note. Genuine care in the commitment. Softer pace than the efficient earlier lines. Almost a handshake — both affirming and grounded.
